text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel had trained thoroughly in 
preparation for this very day. The long 
winter of enduring patience was finally 
over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neither sorrow nor anxiety remained. 
Brimming with confidence, she stepped 
forth on her own feet toward the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).
